title: carex humilis var. nana
intro: Carex humilis var. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Sedge or Small Sedge, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Carex humilis var. nana include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which help in reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
